letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. Today, as the calendar flips quietly, I’m reminded how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with my favorite cutie. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my constant sunrise. No distance can dim the glow you bring into my life; it only makes our love stretch like a golden horizon. I can’t wait to hold you close tonight and forever.
poem:
In deserts bright or rains that play,  
Your love’s the compass, night or day.  
Together we dance, hearts in rhyme,  
Forever yours, till end of time.
